text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The more I race and train, the more
often I notice
that something feels... off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Some days my steps are shallower than I
intend,
or I run out of stamina as if I
started my final
sprint a little too early...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's a very subtle difference, but despite
how
insignificant it seems...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creeeak...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It feels like this body I've always relied
on is
starting to wear away.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'! I'm gonna take full advantage
of summer
camp and get super duper
strong!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, shut up already. You're not the
only one
who's gonna improve here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Look how much energy they've got.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile if I run any more than this,
I'm sure I'll
fall apart...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp season has arrived again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume are lined up in front of the
gates,
waiting for the buses to take them
to summer
camp. Sakura Chiyono O is
among them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her expression is oddly tense,
and she
seems nervous...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer?! O-of course! Summer camp is
a
wonderful opportunity to improve!
choice_data_list: ...Chiyono O, let's give it our all at summer camp!
...Chiyono O, let's do our best at summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've already looked up some effective
ways to
train!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um... This time... I'd like to focus more
on
weightlifting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: As for my running... Um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we save that for the second
half of
camp? It'll be exciting to see how
much my times
have improved!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Is, uh... Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I actually read a number of articles to
prepare for
summer camp, and I've come
up with some new
routines as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of the training menus is geared
toward
Umamusume who are already
past their peak,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If that's not what she wants, it would be
cruel of
me to suggest it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hm? Trainer?
choice_data_list: (Only after that desire sprouts within her, I suppose.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Let's have a great summer
camp
together!
choice_data_list: I'll put together a training menu along those lines.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dash!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could I have a few words
from you
before you head to the
campsite?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Please! The world wants to know the
details!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry, but there will be no
interviews
at this time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow. There are so many reporters here...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They must be here to interview the Top
Three.
They sure are popular.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Please! We'd just like to hear what
Maruzensky
has to say!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now! Don't be like that. Be nice to
Tazuna!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky! Is it true that you won your
first
scrimmage in a long time by seven
lengths?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What's the reason for your return? Is it
because of
the Top Three? Do you see
them as potential
rivals?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm... Well...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's a secret! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I race in the fall! Bye now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vr-vr-vrooooom!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Maruzen?! Please come back,
Maruzeeen!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Wow... She's as amazing as ever. And
here I
thought she was already past her
peak...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's a legend, after all. She's
definitely not
like other Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...They were all here for Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...She's trying to keep our promise.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... I have to do my best too.
